A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MetaOOD study and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables and appendices. Existing material can be matched across the appendix additions and table renumbering.

before.justification: V1 reports original evaluations on 24 test dataset pairs, embedding and meta-predictor ablations, runtime measurements and the detector AUROC matrix.

after.justification: V2 retains these empirical results and adds feature-importance analysis, a combined-feature experiment and a dataset-description sensitivity experiment.

M1.justification: The main language-embedding/XGBoost pipeline and Algorithms 1–2 remain unchanged. Appendix C.1 introduces a Combined variant using statistical and landmarker meta-features alongside language embeddings, a limited extension of the model inputs.

E1.justification: The image datasets and 24 test dataset pairs remain unchanged. The added analyses vary representations and descriptions within the retained coverage; LSUN appears only in a computational-cost discussion, without reported evaluation.

E2.justification: The eleven model-selection baselines in Section 4.2 and eleven candidate OOD detectors in Table 1 are retained. The new appendix boxplots reuse the existing baseline set to assess MetaOOD variants.

E3.justification: The Llama embedding footnote in Section 4.4.1 changes the stated extraction choice from the first token to the last token; the PDFs do not establish a rerun. Added analyses introduce combined-feature and revised-description controls and Weight/Cover/Gain diagnostics. Existing benchmark splits and AUROC evaluation remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Beyond the retained embedding-source, predictor-choice and runtime analyses, v2 adds three substantive investigations: embedding feature importance (B.4), combining handcrafted and language features (C.1), and sensitivity to revised dataset descriptions (C.2). These substantially expand the analysis of representation choices and robustness.

E5.justification: Both versions use the same across-dataset Wilcoxon signed-rank tests and significance threshold, with identical Table 2 results. V2 adds no repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or specified statistical testing procedure for the new analyses.

E6.justification: The original AUROC matrix, main plots and significance results remain unchanged, including MetaOOD's average rank of 3.1667. V2 adds feature-importance results, comparable-performance findings for Combined and revised descriptions, and explicit per-pair selection annotations in Table C. Table E reports average importance weights of 0.53, 0.52 and 0.37 for ID, OOD and method embeddings.

T1.justification: Problem 1, Equations 1–2 and the mathematical procedure remain unchanged. The redrawn Figure 1 retains the existing loss objective; the new notation table explains existing symbols. No theorem, proof or substantive derivation is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims: a first zero-shot, unsupervised OOD model-selection framework using meta-learning and language embeddings, superior selection across the stated testbed, and low runtime overhead.

C2.justification: V2 interprets feature importance as showing greater influence from dataset embeddings and uses Combined's comparable performance to justify language-only inputs on efficiency grounds. It also interprets revised-description results as robustness. The existing historical-data and single-modality limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: V2 supplies the full dataset-description inputs in Table D and modified descriptions in Table F, extending v1's examples. It replaces the anonymous repository address with a named GitHub address and revises the Llama extraction detail. Hardware and the main implementation choices remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Seven references are added, including PyOD 2, DPU, COOD, a trustworthiness survey and the GPT-4 technical report. The GPT-4o mini citation changes accordingly. The related-work organization and central novelty positioning remain substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: The main narrative and section order are retained. V2 makes local terminology and prose edits, explicitly clarifies supervised offline meta-training, adds acknowledgments and notation explanations, and organizes the additional appendix studies into new subsections.

P2.justification: Figure 1 is substantially redrawn to expose performance-matrix construction and supervised fitting. V2 adds four appendix tables and three figures covering notation, descriptions, importance and additional experiments. The retained AUROC matrix becomes Table C and highlights selected entries in bold, substantially expanding the visual and tabular exposition.

improvement.justification: V2 improves transparency through explicit embedding inputs and a clearer training diagram, while the new analyses strengthen support for representation choices. These are useful supporting gains with the main benchmark evidence unchanged. The description-robustness conclusion remains limited: Tables D and F show that the revisions add metadata such as sample counts, so the experiment does not isolate wording changes alone.
